name: Jeffrey Epstein
description: Network investigation rooted in the Epstein case, following evidence across connected structures — Mega Group, Deutsche Bank, Gulf states, Israeli intelligence, Apollo/Black financial flows, and parallel networks.

name: John Hagee
description: Investigation of Pastor John Hagee's financial empire, political influence network, and institutional infrastructure spanning Cornerstone Church, Christians United for Israel (CUFI), John Hagee Ministries, and affiliated entities. Focus on financial flows, real estate holdings, political relationships, and cross-entity governance.

name: Silicon Valley Defense Complex
description: Investigation of the Silicon Valley-to-Pentagon pipeline under the second Trump administration. Tracks revolving door appointments (Emil Michael, Pete Hegseth), defense tech capture (SpaceX, Anduril, Palantir, D-Wave), DOGE government restructuring, and conflicts of interest where tech investors shape defense policy that benefits their portfolios. Focus on financial flows, government contracts, ethics waivers, and institutional capture mechanisms.
